caption: The drawing depicts a round, footed bowl with a wide opening and a matching lid resting against its side. Both the bowl and the lid are brown and appear to be made of wood, as indicated by the visible wood grain texture and concentric circular patterns on their surfaces. The lid is slightly tilted and leans against the bowl, showing its underside, with a knob-like handle at the top for lifting. The bowl has a relatively thick, rounded lip and sits atop a narrow stem that widens at the base, providing stability. The background is plain and off-white, allowing the objects to stand out in the center of the composition. Near the objects, the artist’s name “ROSE CAMPBELL-GRIME” is written in small capital letters.
title: Sugar Bowl with Cover
